# LifeVer

> LifeVer (Semantic Life Versioning) is an open standard for tracking personal accomplishments and significant life events using a changelog format inspired by software release notes and Semantic Versioning.

LifeVer defines a three-part version number (EPOCH.MILESTONE.STEP), five Change Types (Added, Improved, Changed, Fixed, Removed), and an extensible Scope taxonomy for categorizing entries in a plain-Markdown changelog file. It is designed for both human authors and automated/AI systems that read or generate LifeVer-formatted changelogs.

## Core Resources

- [Full Specification (SPEC.md)](https://github.com/LifeVer-Standard/LifeVer/blob/main/SPEC.md): The complete, authoritative standard. Versioning scheme, entry structure, Change Types, Scopes, Guiding Principles, and a worked example.
- [Appendix A: Notes for AI & Automated Systems](https://github.com/LifeVer-Standard/LifeVer/blob/main/SPEC.md#appendix-a-notes-for-ai--automated-systems): Parsing regexes, entry delimiters, and a JSON data model for programmatically reading or generating LifeVer changelog files. Start here if you're building a tool or AI integration.
- [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/LifeVer-Standard/LifeVer/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): Version history of the standard itself (plain SemVer) - not to be confused with an individual's own LifeVer changelog.
- [LICENSE.md](https://github.com/LifeVer-Standard/LifeVer/blob/main/LICENSE.md): CC BY 4.0.

## Website

- [lifever.org](https://lifever.org): Human-facing introduction with an interactive demo. Deliberately simplified - not authoritative. Defer to SPEC.md for exact rules.

## Notes for AI Agents

- Don't treat lifever.org's rendered page as a complete specification. Always consult SPEC.md, and Appendix A specifically for any parsing or generation task, before producing or validating a LifeVer entry.
- The standard's own version number (currently 1.5.0, plain SemVer) is unrelated to any individual's personal EPOCH.MILESTONE.STEP changelog. Don't conflate the two when reasoning about "what version is this."
